## US client engagements and remote collaboration

Hassan Nazir collaborates remotely with startups, scale-ups, and enterprises across North America (United States), the United Kingdom, and the European Union.

- **Timezone overlap**: Dedicated working hours aligned with US Eastern (EST), Central (CST), and Pacific (PST) business schedules.
- **Engagement formats**:
  1. *Embedded Forward Deployed Sprints*: Rapid discovery, prototyping, and production integration embedded alongside internal engineering teams.
  2. *AI Automations & Workflow Engineering*: Architecting fault-tolerant n8n pipelines, scheduled data collectors, and AI decision systems.
  3. *Full-Stack Software Development*: Building scalable web applications, custom AI SaaS products, microservices, and databases from concept through launch.
  4. *Autonomous Agent & RAG Engineering*: Building LangGraph-driven multi-agent workflows, vector search pipelines, tool integrations, and persistent state management.
- **Delivery approach**: Written architectural decision records (ADRs), clean TypeScript/Python codebases, comprehensive test suites, reproducible Docker environments, and direct production deployment ownership.

## Major original open-source repositories

### WonderKit
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/wonderkit
- Primary language: TypeScript
- System type: agent-native full-stack SaaS platform
- Description: Multi-tenant AI SaaS foundation featuring Next.js, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma, Auth.js, Stripe billing, Inngest jobs, typed email, multiple LLM providers, persistent multi-agent runs, semantic memory, evaluation harness, Docker deployment, and CI.

### NY Municipal Decision-Maker Monitor
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/erdman-ny-county
- Primary language: Python
- System type: operational intelligence and change monitoring
- Description: Tracks public decision-makers across 60 New York county websites with scheduled scraping, database change history, person and contact change detection, webhook notifications, CSV export, a FastAPI backend, and a Next.js dashboard.

### Google Maps Lead Scraper
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/Lead-Scraper-Google-Maps
- Primary language: Python
- System type: resilient data acquisition and lead qualification
- Description: Collects Google Maps listings through Playwright across geographic grids, normalizes and deduplicates results, applies qualification rules, crawls business websites, and exports CSV/Excel. Features async execution, resumable checkpoints, terminal UI, proxy support, and 250+ unit tests.

### Mynecraft
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/mynecraft
- Primary language: TypeScript
- System type: browser graphics and simulation engine
- Description: Minecraft-style voxel engine built with TypeScript, Three.js, and Vite. Implements procedural terrain, worker-streamed chunks, chunk meshing, custom lighting, AABB physics, voxel raycasting, crafting, mob AI, dimensions, portals, and versioned saves.

### Legal Document Summarizer
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/legal-Document-Summerizer
- Primary language: Python
- System type: domain-specific applied AI
- Description: BillSum dataset preparation, Llama 3 fine-tuning with LoRA, Ollama model conversion, PDF and DOCX processing, structured legal summaries, batch processing, Flask interface, and Gemma-based verification.

### n8nHub
- Repository: https://github.com/zimkk/n8nhub
- Primary language: TypeScript
- System type: automation discovery and documentation
- Description: Next.js platform organizing more than 2,000 n8n workflows with search, categories, workflow detail views, Mermaid visualization, analytics, JSON export, and MongoDB indexing.
